CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

5. Solve for x: x + 6 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 6

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 24
   D. 48

   D. 43

   B. 1

   D. 17

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13

   C. 5
   D. 37

   A. 33

   C. 22
   D. 14

   A. 19.7

   C. 25

14. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 25
   C. 17
   D. 31

16. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25

   D. 2
